knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "Inflata Nation soft play Glasgow is the best place for a family day out in Glasgow. It is packed with fun soft play inflatable activities including Inflata Bubbles (super springy huge inflatable bubbles that help you leap to the sky), Inflata Wall (soaring high into the eaves of the arena is this challenging climbing wall), Inflata Race (challenge your friends and see who can reach the finishing line first), Inflata Tots (a dedicated area for the under 4’s to enjoy a mini slide, ball pool and soft play), plus much more. If you’re looking for a kid’s party place then look no further than Inflata Nation Glasgow! Your kids will be the favourite in their class having their party at our Glasgow arena."
